releaseNotes: PORTAL SUBMISSION PERMANENT FIX: Auto-schema synchronization on server boot and query-level safe selects guarantee zero Prisma findFirst crashes on payment screenshot or member registration submissions.

REGISTRATION APPROVAL WORKFLOW: New registrations submitted through Universal QR portal now stay PENDING for admin review and approval; members are only reflected in the Member Directory upon admin approval.
MEMBER IDENTITY & DOCUMENTS: Member profile now permanently stores and displays Aadhaar card (front & back) and photo images in high resolution with pinch-to-zoom preview.
CARD ACTION BAR: Added dedicated Archive button directly beside the Delete button on every member card with confirmation dialogs and automatic seat release.
title: Chintamani Library v2.8.11 — Approval Workflow, Identity Gallery & Archive Action
